title: Tail phase schedule
statement: Let $C$ be a clause of literals over natural-numbered variables, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{rest}$ be bit strings with $x=\mathrm{pre}\,\mathrm{enc}(C)\,\mathrm{rest}$. For every fresh cursor $j\in\mathbb{N}$, running $|C|+1$ rounds from tail phase with cursor $j$ and consumed length $|\mathrm{pre}|$ emits the pending tail output for $C$ at cursor $j$, and ends in formula phase with its final cursor and consumed length $|\mathrm{pre}|+|\mathrm{enc}(C)|$.
hypotheses_covered: Clause $C$ of literals over natural-numbered variables
Prefix and suffix bit strings $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{rest}$ satisfying $x=\mathrm{pre}\,\mathrm{enc}(C)\,\mathrm{rest}$
replaced:
Let the input contain a serialized clause tail $C$ at the consumed position, with
the seam in the tail phase at cursor $j$. Then exactly $|C| + 1$ rounds — one per
remaining literal plus one for the clause terminator — consume the serialized
tail, emit exactly the pending tail output of $C$ at $j$, return to the formula
phase, and leave the cursor at the tail's final value.
